evidence: This route begins at Blue Lake Hut in Nelson Lakes National Park.

The track leaves the bush and meets the Alpine Nature Walk. This short track leads through an alpine wetland with spectacular views of Gloriana Peak and the Spenser Mountains. It ends at the state highway and Lewis Pass.

evidence: Alternate Route from the junction on Waiau and Ada Rivers: Rather than taking the route to Lewis Pass, you can instead follow the St James Walkway south, walking through to Boyle Village.
Follow the track downstream from the turnoff to the Ada Valley, crossing various side streams then the Ada River. Cross Ada Flat then Delta Stream, then the track will join the St James Walkway.

doubts: The end of the main way is recorded as the state highway at Lewis Pass, using the map entry for Lewis Pass (T20). The feature at the highway (where Lewis Tops Track meets State Highway 7) is not named in the text, so it is not used. W2 is the page's alternate from the Waiau and Ada junction, which the page describes only from that junction; it is recorded from Blue Lake Hut, sharing W1's start, and ends at Boyle Village (no map entry). The St James Walkway part is on another page and is not described here. Caroline Creek is recorded as a ford because the text says the route crosses the side streams, the largest being Caroline Creek; the crossing is implied rather than stated directly. The lake is recorded as Rotopohueroa/Lake Constance (T23); the map also has Lake Constance (T19) at the same point. Christopher (Ada) Cullers Hut is passed before Ada Pass, so it is listed as a hut on the way. The Caroline Creek Bivvy is removed and is not a hut. DOC's '8-10 days for full trip' is used as the way's time; section times and distances are not summed.
